dataset.title: Melanoma targeted therapies dabrafenib and trametinib cross the placental barrier in ex vivo human placental perfusions

reported_observations.study_flow: Figure 1 reports transfer parameters available for 11 dabrafenib placentas and 7 trametinib placentas after separate eligibility/refusal/perfusion/leakage/antipyrine/dosage-failure stages.
reported_observations.figure_endpoint: Figure 2 plots fetal transfer rates (%) as 11 dabrafenib and 7 trametinib symbols, consistent with Figure 1 transfer-parameter counts. The related IFPA abstract reports group FTR estimates that match the plot centers to visual precision, but does not state that it is the same cohort, define ±, give n, or define the FTR equation.
reported_observations.related_abstract: The IFPA 2025 abstract reports FTR as 8.6 ± 3.1% for trametinib and 15.3 ± 5.4% for dabrafenib, and placental uptake ratios as 7.5 ± 1.4% and 3.7 ± 2.2%, respectively. Neither the meaning of ± nor group denominators are specified; no individual numeric rows are supplied.

eligibility.use_role: figure-level human placental functional-transfer comparator only

scope_limit: A short ex-vivo human placental drug-transfer study; not embryo development, continuous gestation, artificial-environment birth, or later-health evidence.
next_action: Retain as a figure- and abstract-level functional-transfer comparator. Continue public-only screening for the journal figure caption or a linked numeric source that defines the FTR equation, uncertainty statistic and cohort denominator; do not digitize plotted points or use for a dimensional fit.
